decision: Generalize dialog-description as content-description without changing the canonical prop name or dialog APIs.

userStatements.provenance: L12 G1, G4 and U4 plan

limits: DialogContent and AlertDialogContent retain their component-specific accessible-description linkage; ArticleFeature includes its description in the link name.
The previous receipt is immutable history; this record binds only the amended convention.

convention.name: description
convention.meaning: Optional visible short plain text that explains the content or purpose of its element, rendered next to its title
convention.whenToUse: Provide a short explanatory text alongside the title of a content unit or dialog.
convention.avoid: Accessible name or heading (use title), form help (use hint), editorial section introductions (use lede), status notes (use statusText), rich or interactive content.
